items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Well, that was, that was the last band I'm playing. Yeah, Piku, you had a piece there, uh, it's called Get Busy Right.

ctx.x: Yeah. Go ahead and then get your gumbo and your chicken stew. Chicken gumbo and chicken stew. And pardon to use the feet. That is good. Mm-hmm. Then you go up and you play. You might play, um, or you get another little snack of one and you refresh it. It's really good. You play till five o'clock. I had to get two dollars for it. And I don't care why I was waking. When they had one of them, I was waking. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I quit and go to that tunnel.
I was going to ask some more about that band I mentioned before that you played in the Piku. Oh. And the Milton, Mr. Milton was telling us about just two days ago.
